data.name: Madeeha
data.gender_notes: Madeeha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘mudhahaha’, meaning ‘to make much of something, or to glorify’. In Islamic context, it refers to the mother of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) named Amina bint Wahb, who gave him the name ‘Ahmad’ which means ‘most praiseworthy’. The name Madeeha carries the meaning “Mother of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh)” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Madeeha usually hope their child will grow to embody mother of prophet muhammad (pbuh) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the deep love and devotion a mother has for her child.
